excerpt.zh:
通讯协议已经建立。我们现在可以同这个帝国展开外交。他们对我方的当前评价取决于我们在第一次接触时采取的行径。

要展开外交；

£dot_green£在左侧边栏点击通讯按钮或按F10键

                        £contacts£

在第一次接触任务中，我们也获取了一些情报。随着我们逐渐掌握一个帝国的情报，更多有关他们的细节也将为我们所见。

texts.en:
Communications protocols have been established. We can now engage in Diplomacy with this Empire. Their current opinion of us depends on how First Contact was conducted.

To engage in Diplomacy;

£dot_green£Click the Contacts button on the left side bar or press F10

                        £contacts£

During first contact, we also gain Intel. As we gain further Intel on an empire, more details about them become visible to us.
